major_events: In [第593章 太皇剑，九黎图，吞天罐], the supreme imperial weapons Taihuang Sword (太皇剑), Jiuli Tu (九黎图), and the lid of the Heaven Swallowing Pot (吞天罐) are activated in a high-stakes confrontation, showing their immense power.
In [第601章 九千年前中皇再现], the legendary genius cultivator Xiang Yufei (向宇飞), known as the Middle Emperor (中皇), is revealed to have awakened after a nine-thousand-year sleep in Qishi Academy (奇士府).

In [第610章 渡劫得髓], Ye Fan successfully undergoes his heavenly tribulation for the fourth stage of Dragon Transformation (化龙第四变) and enters an ancient underground cave to obtain thirty-six drops of dreamlike dragon marrow (神髓).
In [第616章 秦门], Ye Fan arrives at the mysterious Qin Men (Qin Sect) in the Qin Mountains to search for clues of the legendary Nine Secrets (九秘).
In [第617章 度神], Ye Fan witnesses the application of the Du Shen Formula (度神诀), a brainwashing technique used by the Qin Men leadership to convert external experts into loyal disciples.
In [第625章 对决李小曼], Ye Fan fights his classmate Li Xiaoman, who is wearing a five-colored lotus battle suit (莲花战衣) and practicing the Heaven Swallowing Demon Art (吞天魔功) under Hua Yunfei's direction.
In [第628章 兵字秘], Ye Fan contemplates ancient weapon markings on a stone wall under the moonlight and successfully comprehends the Bing Secret (兵字秘), which grants control over all weapons.
In [第639章 化仙池], a massive gathering of regional powers occurs at the Hua Xian Chi (Immortal Transformation Pool) in the Qin Mountains, drawn by the imminent emergence of ancient emperor treasures.
In [第643章 青帝复生], the residual consciousness of the ancient Qing Emperor (青帝) manifests from the Hua Xian Chi through a green copper block (绿铜块), shocking the assembled cultivators.
In [第645章 妖帝逝去], the manifested spirit of the Qing Emperor departs after resolving the conflict, leaving the dreamlike marrow behind as the treasures disappear.
In [第662章 破阴阳神城], Ye Fan coordinates with the Southern Wilderness barbarian tribe to assault and destroy the sacred city of the Yin-Yang Sect (阴阳教).
In [第667章 太阳真经], Ye Fan translates ancient green-gold sheets containing the Sun Scripture (太阳真经), which reveals that human origins trace back to the Ziwei ancient star field.
In [第678章 永恒的放逐], Ye Fan defeats the Northern Plains Emperor Wang Teng (王腾) and uses an ancient spatial exile technique to banish him to the void.
In [第685章 开棺异动] and [第686章 九龙拉棺重新启航], the Nine Dragons Pulling Coffin (九龙拉棺) is reactivated at the Ji family land and takes off into the starry path with Ye Fan onboard.
In [第695章 降临紫微古星域], Ye Fan lands on the Ziwei ancient star field after traveling across the dark universe, marking the start of a new exploration arc.
In [第700章 老疯子杀太古祖王], the Old Lunatic (老疯子) manifests supreme strength on the Ziwei star, slaying multiple Taigu Kings and an ancient Great Sage.
In [第716章 收伊轻舞], Ye Fan uses the Goddess Furnace (神女炉) to capture and suppress Yi Qingwu (伊轻舞), the top beauty of the Ziwei ancient star.
In [第724章 圣皇最后的血脉], Ye Fan rescues the five-year-old child Tongtong, the last remaining bloodline of the Sun Emperor, from the chasing Jinwu (Golden Crow) tribe.
In [第753章 再临北斗], Ye Fan succeeds in opening a path through the Eight Views Palace (八景宫) to return to the Beidou ancient star.
In [第774章 荒古世家覆灭], Ye Fan leads the Barbarian Tribe army to launch a massive assault on the Beiyuan Wang Family's ancestral home, completely wiping out the family.
In [第783章 太古王族不过如此], Ye Fan fights and defeats the Taigu Prince Zi Tiandu (紫天都), proving that human physical strength can challenge the Taigu Royal Families.
character_state_transitions: Ye Fan: Transitions from Dragon Transformation Stage 3 to Dragon Transformation Stage 4 (化龙第四变) after refining the dragon marrow and surviving the heavenly tribulation in [第610章 渡劫得髓].

Xiang Yufei (中皇): Transitions from a 9,000-year-old sealed, half-dead youth to a revived, active top contender of the new generation in Qishi Academy after being unfrozen and healed by medicine kings in [第601章 九千年前中皇再现] and [第602章 西坝].

Qing Emperor (青帝): Transitions from a long-dead legend to a briefly manifested, active consciousness at the Immortal Transformation Pool before fading away back into history in [第643章 青帝复生] and [第645章 妖帝逝去].

Li Xiaoman: Transitions from a standard Holy Land disciple to a ruthless practitioner of the Heaven Swallowing Demon Art (吞天魔功), wielding a lotus battle suit and attacking her former lover Ye Fan under the guidance of Hua Yunfei in [第625章 对决李小曼].
Wang Teng (北帝): Transitions from an arrogant, undefeated 'Young Emperor' of the Northern Plains to an exiled cultivator banished to the eternal void by Ye Fan's spatial technique in [第678章 永恒的放逐].
Ye Fan: Transitions from the Beidou ancient star to the Ziwei ancient star field after boarding the Nine Dragons Pulling Coffin during the Ji Family conflict in [第685章 开棺异动] and [第695章 降临紫微古星域].

Old Lunatic (老疯子): Transitions from a silent, erratic traveler to an active slayer of ancient kings and a Great Sage (大圣) on the Ziwei ancient star, demonstrating the invincible power of human saints in [第700章 老疯子杀太古祖王] and [第703章 毙大圣].

Yi Qingwu: Transitions from the proud and unapproachable 'first beauty of Ziwei' to a captured and suppressed captive of Ye Fan and the Human Desire Sect disciples using the Goddess Furnace in [第716章 收伊轻舞].

Tongtong (太阳圣皇最后的血脉): Transitions from a helpless, hunted orphan protected by a dying old servant to Ye Fan's disciple and the heir of the Sun Scripture under Ye Fan's protection in [第724章 圣皇最后的血脉] and [第728章 万众瞩目].

The Beiyuan Wang Family: Transitions from a dominant, arrogant ancient family aligned with Taigu Royal Families to complete eradication and destruction by the Southern Wilderness Barbarian Tribe led by Ye Fan in [第774章 荒古世家覆灭].
Ye Fan: Transitions from a traveler on the Ziwei ancient star to a returning hero on the Beidou ancient star after opening a cosmic passage through the Eight Views Palace in [第753章 再临北斗].
long_form_mechanisms: The Du Shen Formula (度神诀) Brainwashing Mechanism: An ancient technique created by the Emperor of Heaven Swallowing / Great Emperor Ruthless that brainwashes targets. Unlike standard mind control, it does not harm the soul or intelligence but alters their fundamental loyalty, causing them to protect and serve the sect with absolute devotion. Cited in [第617章 度神].

The Bing Secret (兵字秘) Weapon Control: One of the legendary Nine Secrets (九秘) that grants the practitioner supreme control over all weapons. It enables them to manipulate and redirect the opponent's weapons, tools, and weapons' spirits in combat, turning their own attacks against them. Cited in [第628章 兵字秘].

The Zuo Wo Ming Dao Formula (斩我明道诀) Regeneration: A supreme cultivation technique used by Wang Teng that allows a cultivator to cut their past self to heal severe injuries and renew their Dao foundation, allowing for instant regeneration of severed limbs. Cited in [第678章 永恒的放逐] and [第679章 斩我明道诀].

One Qi Becomes Three Pure Ones (一气化三清): A supreme Daoist secret technique that allows a cultivator to create three temporary clones of equal power and capability, effectively quadrupling their combat strength in battle. Cited in [第697章 一气化三清].

The Goddess Furnace (神女炉) Suppression: An ancient, pink-hued artifact created by the founder of the Human Desire Sect (人欲道) designed specifically to capture, suppress, and tame powerful female cultivators/beauties. Cited in [第713章 八德宝轮] and [第716章 收伊轻舞].

The Divine Forbidden Realm (神禁领域): A legendary state of combat that transcends the 'Eight-Forbidden' (八禁) limit, allowing a genius cultivator to battle and defeat opponents who are multiple sub-realms or even a major realm higher in cultivation level. Cited in [第718章 神禁领域].

The Sun Emperor Classic (太阳真经): One of the two primary mother scriptures of human cultivation (with the Taiyin Scripture). It cultivates extreme Yang energy and serves as the foundation for human physical cultivation realms. Cited in [第667章 太阳真经] and [第721章 太阳圣皇].

The Immortal Transformation Pool (化仙池) Nurturing: A natural, supreme ley line formation in the Qin Mountains of Central State, where spiritual plants (such as the green lotus that became the Qing Emperor) gain sentience and ancient relic treasures are gathered and nurtured. Cited in [第639章 化仙池] and [第643章 青帝复生].

The Ancient Starry Path (星空古路) Navigation: The mechanism of traveling across the dark universe by reactivating ancient teleportation altars (using coordinates or source power) or boarding the Nine Dragons Pulling Coffin to travel between Beidou and Ziwei planets. Cited in [第685章 开棺异动] and [第695章 降临紫微古星域].
continuity_observations: The Heaven Swallowing Pot (吞天魔罐) Reassembly: The half-deity weapon lid held by Duan De is utilized in major clashes alongside the Jiuli Tu, continuing his role as a gravedigger with half an imperial weapon since early chapters. Cited in [第593章 太皇剑，九黎图，吞天罐].

The Green Copper Block (绿铜块) Catalyst: The rusty green copper fragment from the bronze coffin (obtained by Ye Fan in the beginning of the book) acts as a primary catalyst at Hua Xian Chi to awaken the spirit of the Qing Emperor, maintaining its role as Ye Fan's ultimate treasure. Cited in [第639章 化仙池] and [第641章 绿铜块、源天师齐出].

Li Xiaoman (李小曼) and the Demon Art: Li Xiaoman's persistent training in the Heaven Swallowing Demon Art (吞天魔功) under Hua Yunfei's influence continues her transformation from Ye Fan's Earth classmate to his primary adversary. Cited in [第618章 又见吞天魔功] and [第625章 对决李小曼].

Xiang Yufei (向宇飞) Historical Link: The re-emergence of the Middle Emperor who was sealed 9,000 years ago connects to the Qishi Academy's history of cultivating ancient geniuses to compete in the current era. Cited in [第601章 九千年前中皇再现] and [第602章 西坝].

The Old Lunatic (老疯子) Across Stars: The appearance of the Old Lunatic on the Ziwei ancient star confirms that high-level human experts are also traveling along the starry paths, linking Beidou and Ziwei characters. Cited in [第698章 紫微古域惊见老疯子] and [第700章 老疯子杀太古祖王].

Jiang Taixu (姜太虚) Rebirth Sight: Ye Fan's sudden glimpse of the White-clothed God King Jiang Taixu on an island suggests that he survived his sacrifice for Ye Fan by shedding his God King source, establishing a key hope for the human race. Cited in [第665章 惊见太虚神王].

The Black Emperor (黑皇) Origin: The discovery of Heihuang's scent and hair inside the Purple Mountain (紫山) confirms that the dog was originally sealed there by the Wu Shi Emperor, verifying Ye Fan's long-standing suspicions. Cited in [第792章 黑皇的来历].

Dongfang Ye (东方野) and the Barbarians: The Barbarian tribe's conflict with the Wang family and their subsequent military mobilization to Beiyuan is triggered by the attack on Dongfang Ye's family, linking Ye Fan's barbarian companion to a major war. Cited in [第757章 古村悲壮] and [第768章 铁骑踏荒古世家].

The Nine Dragons Coffin (九龙拉棺) Reactivation: The bronze coffin is used again as a vehicle to travel through space, continuing its role as the ultimate cosmic transport mechanism from Chapter 1. Cited in [第685章 开棺异动] and [第695章 降临紫微古星域].
style_observations: Loud Audio-Visual Onomatopoeia and Hyperbole: The author heavily relies on dramatic sound effects and grand descriptions (e.g., '雷光万丈', '隆隆响动', '血雨腥风') to project the epic scale of saintly battles. Cited in [第610章 渡劫得髓] and [第774章 荒古世家覆灭].

Repetitive 'Spectator Choir' (Passerby Commentary): Critical breakthroughs or battles are always accompanied by reactions of nearby crowds, old elders, or enemies who express awe or explain the power dynamics to the reader. Cited in [第656章 圣体来了] and [第729章 人神共愤].

Classical Chinese Poetic Integration: The narrative frequently embeds classical poetry or rhymes spoken by Daoist figures or old masters to build a mystical and ancient atmosphere. Cited in [第609章 第二位圣人] and [第610章 渡劫得髓].

Serialization Fillers and Recurrent Explanations: The author frequently repeats explanation of concepts (like the history of the nine secrets, the rules of the Dao-severing stage, or the origins of the Holy Body) to accommodate daily online readers. Cited in [第628章 兵字秘] and [第730章 人道共鸣].

Inline Author/Publisher Notes: The text contains inline advertisements or recommendations for other books (such as recommending '《天道永昌》' in Chapter 610), reflecting the digital serialization nature of the text. Cited in [第610章 渡劫得髓].

Repetitive Hyperbolic Epithets: Top figures are constantly labeled with repetitive grand titles (e.g., '北帝', '中皇', '少年大帝', '古今第一妖孽') to maintain their legendary status in the reader's mind. Cited in [第601章 九千年前中皇再现] and [第639章 化仙池].

creation_family_evidence.author: 辰东 (Chen Dong)
key_concepts: 一气化三清 (One Qi Becomes Three Pure Ones)
九龙拉棺 (Nine Dragons Pulling Coffin)
creation_family_evidence.stylistic_signature: Features cosmological-scale travels, intense cultivation progressions (including heavenly tribulations, dragon marrow refinement, and preparation for Dao-severing), epic battles involving ancient mythological entities like the Golden Crows, and traditional Daoist mystical concepts (like Laozi and the Three Pure Ones) adapted into combat arts.
creation_family_evidence.compilation_indicators: The chapter headers are formatted as '第XXX章 Title' (e.g., '第593章 太皇剑') with Chinese characters and numeric digits, using double full-width spaces (　　) for paragraph indentation, which is typical of serialized online web novels compiled for local offline reading.

originality_risks: Direct Borrowing of Daoist Concepts (一气化三清): The supreme technique 'One Qi Becomes Three Pure Ones' is directly borrowed from classical Chinese mythology (specifically Fengshen Yanyi), rather than being an original magical system. Cited in [第697章 一气化三清].

Classical Yin-Yang Duality (太阳与太阴): The concept of the two ultimate scriptures (Sun Scripture and Taiyin Scripture) representing extreme Yang and extreme Yin mirroring each other is a direct adaptation of traditional Chinese wuxia duality tropes (like Jiuyin Zhenjing and Jiuyang Shengjing in Jin Yong's novels). Cited in [第667章 太阳真经] and [第730章 人道共鸣].

The 'Nine Secrets' (九秘) and Nine-Word Mantra: The division of ultimate techniques into nine words (such as '兵' for weapon control) is directly inspired by the Daoist Nine-Word Mantra (临兵斗者皆阵列前行), which is a common trope in Eastern fantasy and Ninjutsu. Cited in [第628章 兵字秘].

Arrogant Elite and Clan Eradication Cycle: The conflict with the Wang family, where the arrogant family proposes to the protagonist's love interest, under-estimates the protagonist, hunts his friends, and gets completely wiped out, follows a highly predictable, repetitive wuxia/xianxia trope. Cited in [第672章 订婚逼战] and [第774章 荒古世家覆灭].

The 'Sleeping Genius / Sealed Legend' Trope: Reintroducing ancient legendary geniuses (like Xiang Yufei sleeping for 9,000 years in source source) to compete with the current generation is a common mechanism in high-fantasy novels to inject higher stakes without natural power creep. Cited in [第601章 九千年前中皇再现] and [第602章 西坝].
